testcase.name: Scenario: Toggle Explore from an expanded panel title menu: target/native-scratch.HSqCy5/current-ribbon-panel-expansion-source/features/application/ribbon-panel-expansion/ribbon-panel-expansion.feature:648:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Toggle Explore from an expanded panel title menu ✔ Given `fixtures/cad/docking-visible-solid-current.opd` is open and active ✔ And the full 3D Model ribbon is at the top ✔ And the Modify additional command area is open and unpinned ✔ When the user right-clicks the lower Modify title ✔ And the user opens the "Show Panels" submenu ✔ Then Explore is checked in the submenu ✔ And the Modify additional commands remain visible ✔ When the user selects Explore in the submenu ✔ Then Explore is hidden and the ribbon panels reflow ✔ And the Modify additional command area closes ✔ When the user opens the Modify additional command area ✔ And the user right-clicks the lower Modify title ✔ And the user opens the "Show Panels" submenu ✔ Then Explore is unchecked in the submenu ✔ When the user selects Explore in the submenu ✔ Then Explore returns to the 3D Model ribbon ✔ And the Modify additional command area closes
